description: Elections Commission - Notify the name of K. H. C. Weerawansha as a member of the Alawwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Alawwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by death. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and election-related declarations.
